q: How long should an Indian MSME keep its carbon accounting records?
title: How long to keep carbon records
short: At least as long as the tax records they come from: GST law asks for accounts to be kept for 72 months from the annual return due date. Keep emissions workings, factors and corrections for the same period, and longer if a loan or contract asks.
audience: MSMEs keeping bills, emissions workings and reports for buyers, lenders or verifiers

ul: Original bills and invoices behind each figure.
The workings: quantities, factors, versions and results.
Base year records, for as long as you report against that base year.
Records behind a sustainability-linked loan, for the loan term.
Records an EU importer may need for CBAM checks, for several years after the import.

p: Keep digital copies with their dates and a way to show they have not been changed since filing.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure linked to its source document, emission factor and method version, so a verifier can trace a total back to the invoice.
